annotation.title_clean: Proyecto de Ley: Observatorio Federal sobre Inteligencia Artificial (O.F.I.A.)
annotation.title_en: Bill: Federal Observatory on Artificial Intelligence (O.F.I.A.)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Honorable Congreso de la Nación Argentina (Senado y Cámara de Diputados)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Argentine bill creating a Federal Observatory on Artificial Intelligence within the executive branch to provide public information, research, consultation and annual reporting supporting reliable, non-discriminatory AI policy. Grounded in the UNESCO Recommendation and the EU AI Act. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates the Observatorio Federal sobre IA (O.F.I.A.) under the national executive
Functions: analyse AI risks and ethics, evaluate regulation, consult experts, publish periodic reports
Composed of ministerial, legislative, provincial and university representatives serving ad honorem
Annual report with proposals for institutional or normative reform
Invites provinces and CABA to adhere; budget adjustments authorised
